utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you know what Rosa actually has scheduled for the repair drive—time, drop-off spot, and what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I don’t have Rosa’s exact schedule on me, but I’m checking around for the 3:30 to 5 pickup window and can ask what needs fixing. If you want, I can try to pin down the drop-off spot too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, pin down the drop-off spot too, and ask Rosa for the repair list so Hana and I know what sorting setup to prep.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard second-hand that they may be aiming for Saturday morning in the community room, but I’m waiting on Rosa to confirm before I spread it. I can set aside screwdrivers and pliers in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — please hold off on spreading it until Rosa confirms, and could you let me know once she confirms the time and the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmation and let you know as soon as I hear the time and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still confirming the drop-off time and exact location so we don’t send folks to the wrong place. I’ll pass it along as soon as I’ve got it verified.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay — so it’s still happening, right? Just send me the confirmed time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still on as far as I know — I just don’t want to repeat the time or spot until I’ve confirmed them. I’ll send you the details directly once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Dane—I'm only logging confirmed repair drive details right now: school gym after pickup Friday, and I’m waiting on direct confirmation for anything else. Have you confirmed a location or time?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not yet — I only have the school gym after pickup Friday confirmed so far. I’m still waiting on the rest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—I’ll keep only the school gym after pickup Friday on the list for now. Please let me know as soon as any other location or time is directly confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’m checking parent availability for the repair drive now that it’s Sunday at the community center—could you bring a basic toolkit or extension cord, and do you know any families who can help around pickup-time constraints?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can bring a basic toolkit, but I can’t confirm any families or pickup-time constraints. Best to check the bulletin or organizer for the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — I’ll put you down for a basic toolkit and check the bulletin/Rosa for the family availability details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam — I’m pulling the top repair needs and signups together now, then I’ll match people to the supplies we’re still missing. If you can help sort tools or donations, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Jules — I’m happy to sort tools or donations. Just point me to what you need me to handle first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Sam — could you start with the tools and set aside anything for the priority repairs? I’ll bring you the updated list as soon as Noah and I finish checking it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks for holding off, Noah — I’m checking with Rosa on the priority repairs and final schedule first, and I’ll send you the exact list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll wait for Rosa’s confirmed list before I say anything, and I’ll keep Jules ready to sort donations around whatever priorities you send.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Noah — I’ll confirm with Rosa and send you the exact priority list and schedule as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, quick check—I’m bringing the screwdriver set, work gloves, and whatever spare tape or screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Bo—thanks. If you’ve got room, toss in any pliers too, but don’t worry if not.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll add pliers if I spot them, but the screwdriver set, gloves, tape, and screws are covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — once you’ve got the gaps, send me the short list and I’ll match it with Sam and Gus so we’re covered before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’m narrowing it down now and I’ll send you the short list as soon as I confirm what Oren and Rey have covered.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — thanks for narrowing it down. Once you send the list, I’ll line up the remaining pieces and keep us on track for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, I’m rounding up bits for the repair drive—Sam’s got a drill and hammer, Oren’s on screws and tape, and Leo may have hand tools, so do you know anyone with a socket set or something broken they’d like fixed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — a socket set would be great if you can find one, and please send anyone with broken items to the folding tables by the entrance so we can log them in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll spread the word about the folding tables by the entrance, and I’ll keep an eye out for a socket set too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, I’ve only got that screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are covered so far — do you know the final time or any missing supplies from the organizer before I pass anything along?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t have the final time yet, but I’m checking on it. If you can pass along any spare screws or tape, that would help too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I’ll pass along that spare screws and tape would help, but I’ll keep the final time marked as still pending until you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Ira — I’m still piecing together the repair drive details, but I know some tools and supplies are being covered. Are you checking what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — I’m checking for any gaps so I can spread the word while I’m out. If you spot anything still needed, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’ve heard Oren may cover screws, tape, and an extension cord, while screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures seem covered too—I'll let you know if Cleo or Uli names any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Ira, quick repair drive update: it’s Saturday morning in the community room, and we’ve got a drill, hammer, screws, tape, screwdrivers, and pliers covered, but I’m still sniffing around for a socket set and anything folks need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out for a socket set while I’m out and spread the word about what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, thanks, Ira — that helps a ton. If you hear of any repairs folks want done, send them my way so I can keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Opal — we’re mostly expecting lamps and small appliances so far, and Rosa’s still settling the time. If you’ve got basic tools or spare bits, they’d likely help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli—I’ll note lamps and small appliances for now; once Rosa confirms the time and location, I can track tools and spare bits against the drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — that would help a lot. I’ll pass along the time and location as soon as Rosa has them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m checking who can still help. Would you be able to pitch in with setup, repairs, or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks for the clear update, Rosa. I can help with setup Sunday morning, and I’ll bring my screwdriver set and pliers unless the organizer says otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Eli—thank you. Please plan on Sunday morning at the community center, and I’ll let you know if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara — I don’t have confirmed time or location yet, since I’m waiting on Rosa, but I’m setting aside screwdrivers and pliers in case they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — please keep those screwdrivers and pliers aside for now, and once Rosa confirms the time and location I’ll fold them into Rey’s tool check.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll keep them set aside and pass along Rosa’s details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, quick version—I’m still bringing the screwdriver set, gloves, and spare tape or screws Saturday, and I’ll drop them at the donation table when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — that’s perfect. Donation table works great, and I’ll make sure someone’s there to sort everything when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—I'll swing by, drop the stuff at the table, and keep moving unless you flag me down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Quinn, I’m still rounding up screws, tape, and maybe an extension cord, and I’m checking if 3:30 to 5 works best for families.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds great, Oren — 3:30 to 5 should work well for families. I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know to bring any extra screws, tape, or help they can spare!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep gathering the screws, tape, and extension cord, and I’ll be there around 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Gus, I’m still checking the repair drive supply gaps—Oren may bring screws, tape, and an extension cord, and Rey has basic tools covered, so I’ll let you know what we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — keep me posted on the gaps, and I can bring extra tools or whatever else we’re still short on for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I’m double-checking the date and location too, since I’ve heard Friday at the school gym as well as Sunday, and I’ll tell you the real gaps once that’s squared away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rey, I’m happy to help with the repair drive—do you need me to bring tools or pitch in on a specific repair?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — I’m still getting the exact list, but tools like screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are already covered. If you want, I can check what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, please do — thanks, Rey. Just let me know what’s still needed for the repair drive and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo — I’m trying to line up the repair drive around school pickup times. What window works best for families?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning 9 to 11 works best—early enough before errands, but not during pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I heard Rosa moved the drive to Sunday at the community center, so would a 9 to 11 window still work for families then?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, the only confirmed thing I’ve got is that screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are covered, and we’re still waiting on the organizer for the final time and any missing supplies.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—can you let me know what still needs repairing and when the final time is confirmed? I’ll jump in once I have those details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the final time and what still needs repairing as soon as the organizer confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—I’m still a bit scattered. What time and drop-off spot are we using again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I don’t have that confirmed yet, Noah — I’m still waiting on Pia or Ira for the exact time and drop-off spot, so please don’t share anything specific until we hear directly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I won’t pass along any specifics yet. I’ll wait for Pia or Ira to confirm and let you know as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, I can help Saturday morning, but I need the basics first: what time, where’s drop-off, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — Saturday 9 to 11 works great, and yes, sorting by the folding tables near the entrance would help a lot; if you can bring the labels, bins, and your basic tool kit, I’ll match that with the priority repairs and signup count.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll be there 9 to 11 with labels, bins, and my basic tool kit. Who should I check in with when I arrive?
